# asym (Asymmetric.al)

> Open-source software for Christian missions organizations covering website publishing, giving, receipts, donor care, missionary micro-CRMs, and office workflows on one shared ground truth, with practical AI in development.

Built by Asymmetric.al, an independent, for-profit software company built first for Christian missions organizations where staff raise designated support, and designed cleanly for any donor-supported nonprofit. Founded by Conrad (who co-leads Global Fellowship, a missions organization) and Blake. Named for asymmetric leverage: helping a small office serve a large mission with care, without adding software drag or vendor lock-in.

## Vision
- One shared ground truth: unite your public website, Donor portal (`apps/donor`), Missionary workspace micro-CRMs (`apps/missionary`), and Mission Control (`apps/admin`) on shared giving tables with server-enforced donor privacy and direct organization Stripe accounts (0% gift markup).
- Practical AI, grounded in live records (in development): AI built on top of the same open permissions to draft thank-yous, partner updates, and routine donor replies, with people editing and approving before anything goes out ("AI drafts; people send.").

## Status
- Public codebase: [Asymmetric-al/core](https://github.com/Asymmetric-al/core) (AGPL-3.0-only, 5,200+ commits on develop, 600+ repository-wide merged PRs since January 2026, verified November 2026 at `1120dc5f9`).
- In public code: authenticated Donor portal with giving history, recurring-gift management, individual receipts, and settled-only annual tax statements (`apps/donor`, `packages/api/src/donor-portal/statements.ts`); assignment-scoped Missionary workspace micro-CRMs defaulting non-opted-in supporters to `Anonymous partner` with per-row totals hidden (`apps/missionary`, `packages/api/src/missionary-portal/donors.ts`); Mission Control CRM, Payload Web Studio website tools, and pre-posting batch previews (`apps/admin`, `packages/api/src/admin/contribution-batches/preview.ts`); direct per-organization Stripe account connections (`packages/api/src/stripe/tenant-client.ts`, `packages/api/src/donate/fee-policy.ts`).
- Building now: public missionary and project directories wired to live organization data (replacing `@asym/mock-data` demo profiles in `apps/donor`), paper check / cash / split church remittance batch saving (`packages/api/src/admin/contributions/offline-dependencies.ts`, ADRs 0004, 0010, and 0012), and agency workflows in `openspec/`.
- Next (not open yet): grounded AI care-work drafting, published flat managed hosting tiers, Finance-verified parallel-close onboarding (February through September only, never November through January), and optional managed donor care.
